span.label: how interneurons coordinate their activity within a subpopulation, given that the populations inhibit each other and sit in a densely interconnected network

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Four converging circuit mechanisms recruit members of the same interneuron class: electrical coupling, absent or scarce within-population inhibition, disinhibition via inhibition of the reciprocally inhibitory class, and cholinergic self-excitation of VIPs.
span.note: duplicate of: mechanisms[4]
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: VIPs inhibiting SOMs (and vice versa) removes inhibition from their own population members, so firing in a few cells raises the co-activity of the whole population.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Acetylcholine produced by VIPs recruits further VIPs that are themselves ACh-sensitive, closing a positive feedback loop.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Strongly facilitating, slow-kinetics inhibitory synapses between SOMs and VIPs grow during sustained firing, sustaining disinhibition of the partner population over hundreds of milliseconds.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: four mechanisms recruit members of the same class: electrical coupling, absent or scarce within-population inhibition, disinhibition through the reciprocally inhibitory population, and self-excitation of VIPs
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: and a fifth from outside: the surrounding excitatory network drives each population with its own synaptic dynamics, depressing onto VIPs and facilitating onto SOMs
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the recruitment of VIPs by exogenous ACh and their mecamylamine-sensitive population-recruitment, combined with their ability to produce ACh, suggest that ambient ACh recruits a positive feedback loop via VIPs
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: separating the excitatory sources of two mutually inhibitory populations is likened to agonist and antagonist muscles, where contracting both at once would waste energy
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the proposed function is supralinear amplification of one kind of inhibition as demand grows, for instance before excitation overwhelms the circuit
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The proposed mechanisms are supported mostly by correlation because the cell-type-specific loss-of-function tools needed do not exist.
span.note: what this limits: every mechanistic claim in the paper: SUITABLE LOSS-OF-FUNCTION EXPERIMENTS TO TEST THE CONTRIBUTION OF THESE MECHANISMS ... DO NOT YET EXIST, so the support is correlational by necessity rather than by choice
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Broad optogenetic activation also stimulates axon terminals, so the recruitment results may reflect complex network interactions rather than direct drive.
span.note: what this limits: the recruitment results specifically: THIS BROAD ACTIVATION OF THE LOCAL MICROCIRCUIT INCLUDES AXON TERMINALS EXPRESSING C1V1, THEREFORE THESE RESULTS MAY BE DUE TO MULTIPLE COMPLEX NETWORK INTERACTIONS
